_comment: All abstraction detection rules. Loaded by src/engines/ruleEngine.js. Edit here, never in JS.

patterns.fix: Make the movement happen physically. Don't say she tries — write what the body does.
Convert to body: breath, grip, jaw, stomach, weight, pressure.
Make the threat immediate. Write what the body does right now.

patterns.reason: meaning or interpretation instead of sensation
patterns.fix: Remove explanation. Show body, contact, pressure, or breath instead.
Replace the thought with a physical movement.
Remove the cause. Split into pure physical beats.
Convert the label to body pressure, breath, grip, eyes, posture, or distance.

patterns.reason: aesthetic judgment instead of physical specificity
patterns.fix: Show what makes it that. A body reaction, a specific detail, a sensation.

patterns.reason: observed interpretation, not direct physical fact
patterns.fix: Write the physical fact, not the inference drawn from it.

patterns.reason: adverb qualifying motion instead of showing it
patterns.fix: Remove the adverb. Show the speed or quality through the movement itself.
